The structure of La2Cu8Se4S4 (reduced formula La(Cu2SSe)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 194), with 18 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis gives Cu centers 4 neighbors each (S, Se, or mixed), La centers 8 neighbors (4 S, 4 Se), and S centers 11 neighbors (4 Cu, 4 La, 3 S). The geometric neighbor graph is a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between S-centered 11-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing between Cu- and La-centered polyhedra.
